preconditions.description: Number of railway stations is between 2 and 5000.
Number of railway sections is exactly n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in sections)
preconditions.description: Each railway section connects two different stations within the range [1, n].
Number of passengers is between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b and 1 <= g <= 10**6 for a, b, g in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query specifies two different stations within the range [1, n] and a minimum scenery beauty value between 1 and 10^6.

postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' indicating no valid solution or a list of n-1 integers representing the scenery beauty values.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= f <= 10**6 for f in return_value if return_value != '-1')
postconditions.description: Each scenery beauty value is between 1 and 10^6.

postconditions.expression: all(min(f for f in path_values(a, b)) >= g for a, b, g in queries)
postconditions.description: For each query, the minimum scenery beauty along the path from a to b is at least g.
